steps.reason: name is personal data and unique per passenger; ticket and home.dest are high-cardinality text with no usable structure; cabin is 78% missing. boat (lifeboat) is assigned only to people who survived and body only to people who died, so both leak the target and would not exist when predicting survival.
Stratified so the 38% survivors are represented in the same share in train and test.

20% of the ages are missing; the median is robust to the long right tail. The indicator keeps the fact that age was unknown: ages are missing for 29% of the third-class passengers against 6% of the second-class ones, and survival differs (28% against 41%).
One fare is missing; the median is robust to the very skewed fares.
Two embarkation ports are missing; the most frequent port is the safe fill.
Text categories with two or three values; one-hot avoids an invented order.

Fare, sibsp and parch are skewed with outliers, so the robust scaler is used for all numeric columns. The model family is open and may include linear models; scaling costs trees nothing and puts linear models on comparable footing.
